summary: Tells code where it is running, which helps in shared scripts used on both the server and clients.

isClient.exampleLua:
-- A file listed in sharedScripts runs on both sides.
local side = (kcds.core.Runtime.isClient and "client" or "server")
print("running on the " .. side)

isServer.exampleLua:
local Runtime, Events = kcds.core.Runtime, kcds.core.Events

if Runtime.isServer then
  Events.on("playerReady", function(player) return print(player.nickname .. " is in") end)
end

apiVersion.summary: The version of the script API.

serverVersion.summary: The KCDS version on this side, or '' if unknown.

serverDir.summary: The server's folder, which holds resources/ and server.json. On a client it is null. A deployment replaces the resource's own folder, process.cwd(), so keep saved data under this one.
serverDir.example:
const path = require('node:path');

const dataFolder = path.join(kcds.core.Runtime.serverDir, 'data', 'my-resource');
serverDir.exampleLua:
-- Lua scripts reach no files: a JavaScript resource of yours saves under this folder
print("data goes under " .. kcds.core.Runtime.serverDir .. "/data/my-resource")
serverDir.exampleCs:
// C# scripts reach no files: a JavaScript resource of yours saves under this folder
Log.Info($"data goes under {Runtime.ServerDir}/data/my-resource");
